name: crossway_troublemakers_blocking_vampire_no_lifelink_may_decline
notes: M5 mapper. Printed: 'Attacking Vampires you control have deathtouch and lifelink. Whenever a Vampire you control dies, you may pay 2 life. If you do, draw a card.' On seat 1's turn Opp Ogre (3/3) attacks and seat 0's Vampire (2/2) blocks: a blocking Vampire is not attacking, so it has neither lifelink (seat 0 gains nothing) nor deathtouch (the Ogre survives with 2 damage marked). The Vampire dies; seat 0 declines to pay ('skip'): no life paid, no card. Seat 1's own Vampire is then destroyed: not seat 0's, no offer at all.
